title: The Vignelli Canon & Modern Brand Scaling
discipline: Massimo Vignelli Canon · Unigrid Architecture · Typographic Scale Jumps · Brand Identity System
hypothesis: Can Massimo Vignelli's uncompromising modernist canon—the Unigrid modular architecture, four disciplined type scale jumps, and stark monochromatic restraint—serve as the ultimate antidote to contemporary visual noise, engineering a bulletproof brand identity that scales across any digital medium?
